name: Duomo
neighborhood: Ibla, by the Cathedral of San Giorgio
what_to_order: Free-range lamb with Sicilian 'mole', grilled green beans and a sea-and-mountain vegetable jus · Stupor Mundi tasting menu
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04; star confirmed in the 2026 edition ceremony list (Nov 2025)
verdict: The deepest single meal on this coast if you want Sicily argued from first principles.
caveat: Rooms are small and intimate; book well ahead. Expensive.

name: Cortile Spirito Santo
what_to_order: Monkfish meunière, wild fennel and asparagus · Ricordo di una 'scacciata' catanese · Assoluto di mandorla · Omaggio al Bosca
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04; star confirmed in the 2026 edition ceremony list (Nov 2025)
verdict: The one starred table in Ortigia; technical, almost baroque, terrace in summer.

name: Crocifisso
what_to_order: Artichoke two ways on brioche with anchovy sauce · Cod, leek foam, cuttlefish ink, black truffle, basil oil · Meat and vegetarian options
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04; star confirmed in the 2026 edition ceremony list (Nov 2025)
verdict: The serious table in Noto, above the tourist stretch of Corso Vittorio Emanuele.
caveat: Closed Wednesdays (per MICHELIN page); dinner service.

name: Dabbanna
what_to_order: Ciauru ri mari · Poached egg, ricotta cream, hazelnuts, bread and truffle
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04
verdict: Family-history cooking with a Latin-American seam, run by a female dining team.

name: Lorenzo Ruta
address: C.da Zimmardo SP45 km5,   RG, Modica
what_to_order: Mallard tortelli · Meat and fish tasting menus
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04
verdict: The ambitious Modica table now that Accursio's fine-dining room has closed.
caveat: Out of town, need a car.

name: Cantine Pupillo — Castello del Solacium
what_to_order: Moscato di Siracusa · Light lunch at the Solacium
notes: Own site live 2026-10-04 with tasting page and new wine-bar notice
verdict: The one place to taste the wine Syracusans claim descends from the ancient Pollio.

name: COS
what_to_order: Cerasuolo di Vittoria Classico · Pithos Rosso / Bianco · Frappato
notes: Own site live 2026-10-04 with visit booking contacts
verdict: A detour west of Noto, but the clay-pot wines explain Sicilian natural wine better than any bar.
caveat: Office hours are weekday-only; book well ahead.

name: Arianna Occhipinti
what_to_order: Il Frappato · SP68 Rosso
notes: Own site live 2026-10-04 with booking link
verdict: Pair with COS for a day on Frappato.

name: Latteria Mamma Iabica
neighborhood: Via G.B. Perasso, just off Ortigia
what_to_order: Burrata with ficazza di tonno · Polpo in umido alla Camilleri
notes: Awarded Chiocciola in Osterie d'Italia 2026 (published Oct 2025)
verdict: The Slow Food pick in Siracusa city.
caveat: Dish detail comes from the national tourism site, not a critic.

name: Don Camillo
what_to_order: Spaghetti delle Sirene · Desserts
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04
verdict: The Ortigia classic; save room for dessert, MICHELIN says.
caveat: No longer starred (it is listed, not starred, in 2026).

name: Regina Lucia
what_to_order: Classic Sicilian dishes, reinterpreted · Desserts
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04
verdict: Pay for the square; MICHELIN says don't skip dessert.
hot_this_month: October 2026: open Wed–Mon 12:00–23:00 — the verified last-minute table on Piazza Duomo (seen 5 Oct).

name: Radici – L’Osteria di Accursio
what_to_order: Traditional Sicilian dishes · Spremuta di Sicilia
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04
verdict: A former one-star chef cooking trattoria food: excellent value.

name: Taverna La Cialoma
what_to_order: Day's fish, simply cooked · Tuna preparations
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04
verdict: The place to eat fish in Marzamemi.

name: Cortile Arabo
what_to_order: Fish-focused tasting dishes · A few meat dishes
notes: Listed in the current MICHELIN Guide Italia selection on guide.michelin.com, page read 2026-10-04
verdict: The dressier option in Marzamemi.

name: Campisi (conserve and restaurant)
what_to_order: Busiate con bottarga di tonno · Ventresca di tonno
notes: Conserve web store live (seen 2026-10-04); restaurant listed by Gambero Rosso Jul 2024.
verdict: Buy bottarga, ventresca and Pachino tomato conserves; eat the bottarga pasta.
caveat: Restaurant season not confirmed for October 2026.

name: Caffè Sicilia
recognition: Gambero Rosso Pasticceri e Pasticcerie 2026 — Tre Torte; Bar d'Italia — Tre Chicchi e Tre Tazzine
what_to_order: Granita di mandorla · Cassata · Brioche col tuppo · Latte di mandorla
notes: Own site with posted hours (seen 2026-10-04); Tre Torte 2026 reported 14 Nov 2025; Gambero Rosso granita list 6 Jul 2026.
verdict: Non-negotiable: almond granita, then whatever fruit is in season; buy almond butter for the galley.
caveat: The site shows two different sets of hours on the same page; ring before a late visit.
hot_this_month: Gambero Rosso Pasticceri e Pasticcerie 2026: Tre Torte.

name: Antica Dolceria Bonajuto
what_to_order: Cinnamon chocolate · 'Mpanatigghi · Candied orange in chocolate
notes: Own site live with shop and Fattojo tours (seen 2026-10-04).
verdict: Taste the cinnamon and vanilla bars and 'mpanatigghi; book the Fattojo bean-to-bar visit.

name: Rosy Bar
what_to_order: Cremolata di fichi · Spumone al caffè
notes: Gambero Rosso miniguide 6 Jul 2026.
verdict: Order the cremolata of the day; it is the local form, not the Catanese one.

name: Barcollo
neighborhood: Piazza Cesare Battisti, by the Temple of Apollo
what_to_order: Signature cocktails · Tapas
notes: Forbes Italia 2025 feature
verdict: Ortigia's best drink.

name: Grand Hotel Ortigia — La Terrazza
neighborhood: Viale Mazzini, facing the Porto Grande
what_to_order: Spritz or local spumante · Light bites
notes: Own site live 2026-10-04 listing the sunset aperitivo
verdict: One apéritif here to watch the Porto Grande go gold.
caveat: Non-guest access not stated on site; call ahead.
hot_this_month: October 2026: rooftop dinner 19:30–22:30 (hotel site, 5 Oct); call — non-guest access is not stated.

name: Enoteca Solaria
what_to_order: Bruschetta · Salumi and cheese boards
notes: Natural-wine app listing only
verdict: Ortigia's wine bar; go early, sit at the counter, ask for Etna growers you cannot buy at home.
caveat: Small; liveness for 2026 not confirmed on an own site.

name: Caseificio Borderi
what_to_order: House panino · Ricotta fresca
notes: Tour-operator blog dated 1 Aug 2026 and a May 2025 travel post describe it trading; no own site or press source read.
verdict: Go before 10:30 or skip it in July–August; buy ricotta and mozzarella for the boat either way.
caveat: Summer queues reported up to 1.5 hours; panini reported at €8–10; hours reported Mon–Sat 7:00–16:00 (secondary sources only).

name: Fratelli Burgio — La Salumeria
what_to_order: Tagliere misto · Filuneddu con pecorino e caponata
notes: Own site live, ©2026, describes La Salumeria in the market (seen 2026-10-04).
verdict: The sit-down alternative to Borderi's queue; also the galley-stocking stop for conserves.
